readingNote: judge = from the card shown to the mark, including reading the draft and its message (median 53.5 s; 20 cards ≈ 18 min). remark = from the mark to recording it (median 1.3 s; almost no remarks were written).
authorNote: The author has never dealt with this fictional company or its clients. Seeing them for the first time, the polite, plausible drafts looked acceptable, so 18 of 20 were marked ○. This is the situation the product addresses: a successor who does not know the history would send the AI draft as it is; only someone who knows the history can correct it.
proseSkipped: Writing the same etiquette as prose was not done: the author had no experience of these clients to write it from, so the task did not apply. The judging-vs-writing comparison was therefore not measured; no writing time exists and none is to be assumed (D-059).
